This plot is small, only about half a hectare, and I grow something other than the main cereals here, so I don't put as much money into it as my teff or maize fields. I have some schooling and I know fertilizer helps, but prices are high, so I only use a little DAP at planting and spread manure from my cattle, which costs me nothing. I use seed I saved from last year — improved seed for this crop is hard to find in my kebele, and I trust what I know. I depend on the rains like everyone in Oromia, and my family does most of the work, though at weeding and harvest I bring in a few neighbors and pay them in kind.
